seoTitle: Clear Your TradingView Chart of Drawings & Indicators
metaDescription: Learn how to remove drawing tools and indicators from a cluttered TradingView chart using the object tree, on both desktop and mobile.
intro: A cluttered TradingView chart full of old trendlines and indicators can slow down your analysis. This guide shows how to clear individual drawings, remove all annotations at once, and delete indicators using the object tree, without disturbing your saved chart settings.

steps.heading: Remove individual drawing tools
steps.body: Select a specific trendline, shape, or annotation on the chart and delete it without affecting anything else.

steps.heading: Clear all drawings with one click
steps.body: Use the clear-all option to remove every drawing and annotation from the chart at once, giving you a clean layout instantly.

steps.heading: Delete indicators separately
steps.body: Indicators can be removed individually so you keep the drawings you want while clearing out unused studies.

steps.heading: Use the object tree for control
steps.body: The object tree lists every element on your chart, making it easier to find and remove specific drawings or indicators precisely.

steps.heading: Save or discard layout changes
steps.body: After clearing your chart, decide whether to save the cleaner layout or discard the changes to keep your original setup intact.

steps.heading: Works on desktop and mobile
steps.body: These clearing steps apply whether you're using TradingView on a desktop browser or the mobile app.

faq.question: Can I clear my whole chart with one click?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView offers an option to clear all drawings and annotations from the chart in a single action.

faq.question: Will clearing the chart delete my saved indicators too?
faq.answer: Indicators can be removed separately from drawings, so you have control over what stays and what gets cleared.

faq.question: What is the object tree used for?
faq.answer: The object tree lists all chart elements, letting you select and delete specific drawings or indicators with more precision.

faq.question: Does clearing my chart affect my saved layout?
faq.answer: You can choose to save or discard the changes, so your original saved layout isn't automatically overwritten.

faq.question: Can I clear charts on the TradingView mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, the same drawing and indicator clearing options are available on the TradingView mobile app.
